C185.name: Kaskazini A District
C185.documented: large waves on the north shore, strong winds, heavy rain, boat accidents, and cholera

area.en: Kaskazini A: Nungwi and northern coast
area.sw: Kaskazini A: Nungwi na pwani ya kaskazini

risk.en: This area has tourist beaches and fishing villages where coastal erosion and storm tides damage buildings and rough seas endanger boats.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina fukwe za utalii na vijiji vya wavuvi ambapo mmomonyoko wa pwani na mawimbi makubwa huharibu majengo na bahari chafu huhatarisha vyombo.

advice.en: For those living, fishing and running tourism here, it helps to build back from the shoreline, protect coral and mangroves and stay ashore in strong winds. What raises the risk: building hotels and houses on the beach front, breaking coral or cutting mangroves for construction, mining sand from the beach and taking boats or swimmers out when the wind is rising. Know the higher ground inland that residents and guests will move to when a storm-tide or strong-wind warning is given, and agree with the hotels and the sheha how guests will be warned and moved. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi, kuvua na kufanya utalii hapa, ni vyema kujenga mbali na ufukwe, kulinda matumbawe na mikoko na kubaki ufukweni upepo mkali unapovuma. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga hoteli na nyumba ufukweni, kuvunja matumbawe au kukata mikoko kwa ujenzi, kuchimba mchanga ufukweni na kutoa vyombo au waogeleaji upepo unapopanda. Fahamu eneo la juu la ndani ambalo wakazi na wageni watahamia tahadhari ya mawimbi ya dhoruba au upepo mkali inapotolewa, na kubalianeni na hoteli na sheha jinsi wageni watakavyotahadharishwa na kuhamishwa. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C186.name: Kaskazini B District
C186.documented: coastal floods, large waves, heavy rain, and boat accidents

area.en: Kaskazini B: inland farmland and coral ground
area.sw: Kaskazini B: mashamba ya ndani na ardhi ya matumbawe

risk.en: This area has inland farmland on thin coral soils where dry spells damage crops, water is scarce and storm water floods low hollows.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina mashamba ya ndani kwenye udongo mwembamba wa matumbawe ambapo vipindi vya ukavu huharibu mazao, maji ni haba na maji ya dhoruba hufurika mashimo ya chini.

advice.en: For those farming here, it helps to harvest rainwater, plant drought-tolerant crops and keep homes out of low hollows. What raises the risk and to the loss in a dry spell: building in the coral hollows where storm water collects, relying on one crop on the thin soils, and leaving water standing in open containers after the rains. Know the higher ground your household will move to when the hollows fill in a heavy storm, and agree early where water and food will come from when the dry spell runs long. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima hapa, ni vyema kuvuna maji ya mvua, kupanda mazao yanayostahimili ukame na kujenga nje ya mashimo ya chini. Kinachoongeza hatari na hasara wakati wa kiangazi: kujenga kwenye mabonde ya matumbawe ambako maji ya dhoruba hukusanyika, kutegemea zao moja kwenye udongo mwembamba, na kuacha maji yakituama kwenye vyombo wazi baada ya mvua. Fahamu eneo la juu ambalo kaya yako itahamia mabonde yanapojaa dhoruba kali, na kubalianeni mapema maji na chakula vitatoka wapi kiangazi kikirefuka. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.
